newsitem.title: SPAIN: Continental or AA may soon agree Aerolineas stake.
newsitem.headline: Continental or AA may soon agree Aerolineas stake.

text.p: Spain's Iberia said on Wednesday that American Airlines or Continental Airlines could soon agree to take a 20 percent stake in Aerolineas Argentinas.
"Both American Airlines and Continental have a great interest...in Aerolineas Argentinas and an accord could be concluded in the next two months," chairman Xabier de Irala told reporters.
De Irala said the stake would be "a minority stake of 20 percent." Iberia holds a 10 percent stake in Aerolineas.

Iberia sources said, however, that Iberia would not sell its own stake. Continental or American may buy the stake from Aerolineas' major shareholder Andes Holdings, which currently holds a 63 percent stake.
"We should know in the next 10-15 days, which airline has succeeded in securing the stake," said one source.
